_comment: THE TOOL IMPLEMENTATION LAYER of the harness, created 2026-10-01 for bean w2gr. The owner's rulings: (2026-09-30, option A) tool DEFINITIONS stay in cat-harness (cat-harness/tools/ and its discover.ts reader) and this instance IMPLEMENTS them -- the split bootstrap / bootstrap-tools already uses; (2026-10-01) the content core does NOT depend on this instance, so the document adapter was cut into a server-free content class and a server wrapper -- SUPERSEDED the same day by ruling C1, which put this layer BELOW the content core (see `_needs_comment`): the core may depend on it, it may not depend on the core, and a server part that needs the core moves up into it; (2026-10-01) it carries its OWN package.json, like bootstrap-tools; and a content package's own server half lives in a named subgraph of that package rather than here. Step 3a moves the standalone MCP server (adapters/mcp-server/) in and nothing else, so this declaration names only what exists (bean dh4f). The layout MIRRORS cat-harness's (adapters/, src/, test/) so that, as step 3b moves src/ here, the relative imports between modules that move together come out unchanged.

_avatar_comment: A wrench — what implements the harness's tool definitions. Moved here from cat-harness/schemas/avatars.ts, 2026-10-05 (bean sod4 #4): an instance declares its own mark.

directories.description: The standalone MCP server (`adapters/mcp-server/`): its tool registrars, the declared tool groups that load them, and the Dockerfile that packages it. Moved from `cat-harness/adapters/mcp-server/` (bean `w2gr`, step 3a) because it is a server, and the owner ruled that tool implementations live here while their definitions stay in cat-harness.

Tests of cat-harness's schemas that exercise tools code: the sixteen `cat-harness/schemas/*.test.ts` files that imported `scripts/`, `src/`, `content/pipeline/` or `test/support/`, moved first (bean `70lx`, batch B0) so that no later batch of the code move leaves a harness file importing into this layer. The Zod sources they test stay in cat-harness and follow in stage 1b (bean `8lcl`). `code`, not `schemas`: nothing here is a schema definition.

Scripts this layer runs. Holds `lib/roots.ts`, the one place that names the three roots a moved file can mean (HARNESS_ROOT, TOOLS_ROOT, REPO_ROOT), and its test; the harness's own `scripts/` arrives here batch by batch in the code move (bean `70lx`). Also the identifier lookup's pair, moved here from large-datasets when it dissolved into cat-harness (bean `j7ql`, 2026-10-01; D1: code goes to cat-harness-tools): `gen-id-lookup.ts` builds the prefix-sharded lookup over a catalogue's REFERENCED nodes for every instance that declares an `id-lookup` directory, and writes it THERE (`bun run id-lookup`, gated by `id-lookup:check`); `bench-id-lookup.ts` measures it at full catalogue scale on a seeded synthetic corpus (bean `4pm8`). Neither names a corpus: both read the checkout's declarations. And `extract-assets.ts`, the tool behind the harness's `asset-extraction` skill: a container's INDEX into a `folio-extraction/v1` record, moved down from `folio-assistant-core/scripts/` with its contract `cat-harness/schemas/extraction.ts` (bean `tlat`, placement PR5, owner ruling 2 of 2026-09-30).

The identifier-lookup CLIENT a reader's browser runs: `lookup.js` (plain ES module, no dependencies) with its hand-written `lookup.d.ts`, and a one-form `index.html` told which index to open by `?index=<directory>`. The indexes themselves are generated output hosted by the instance each is about (`who-iris/id-lookup/`), never here. JavaScript, so it never sits under the plain docs pipeline. Moved from large-datasets (bean `j7ql`).

Tests of the code this layer holds, moved with their subjects so the harness keeps no test importing upward into this layer: `composition-roots` (the declared tool groups and route mounting) and `mcp-graph-tools`.

The MCP and HTTP server — what `bun run start` and `.mcp.json` start, from `src/index.ts`: the composition roots (`server.ts`, `route-groups.ts`, `tool-groups.ts`), the plug-in contract `types.ts`, the MCP tool registrars (`tools/`), the harness's own routes (`routes/branches.ts`, `routes/chat.ts`), authentication (`auth/`, `core/github-auth.ts`), access control (`core/rbac.ts`), the MCP projection (`mcp/`) and the no-content adapter. Moved from `cat-harness/src/` in stage 1a's first batch (bean `70lx`, B1). The Tool nodes it serves stay DECLARED in `cat-harness/tools/` with their original `src/tools/*` paths, and the loader finds each module here through `needs` (owner ruling "Trap 1"); the content routes (feedback, glossary, relevance) went UP to the content layer that owns their content instead, and the route loader finds them the same way (owner, 2026-10-04).

_needs_comment: The layers this instance sits on: cat-harness, whose Tool DEFINITIONS it implements, and bootstrap-tools, the tool layer one level down. Owner ruling C1 (2026-10-01, epic 7x5n, bean rmi6): this layer sits BELOW the content core -- the order is bootstrap, bootstrap-tools, cat-harness, this layer, then the content layers. It declared the content core as its one need until then, for the document adapter's server wrapper; the placement audit measured 0 of this layer's 27 files importing the core, so the edge was declared and never used. The core now needs THIS layer, and the reverse edge -- anything here importing a layer above -- is wrong-direction, which `check:import-direction` enforces from the declared `needs` lists rather than from any table. The layer above is deliberately not named here: a lower layer naming a higher one is the wrong direction `check:reference-direction` grades.
_canonicalUrl_comment: A placeholder base under this repository's own publication root, not a FHIR canonical. It exists because a Tool node's I/O type IRIs are minted against it at load and Zod refuses a relative one.
_name_comment: THE NAME IS NOT AN INSTANTIATION CLAIM. Instantiation is a `<name>.config.json` at the repository root (`harness-tiles`, bean `6n23`), and there is none for this layer. Staged as a sibling directory like bootstrap-tools; after the split it becomes its own repository and only `livesAt` changes.
